title: Seraphic Pugilist Gloves
summary: Gloves add 1d4 Radiant to unarmed hits and cast level 4 Guiding Bolt.

fields.Guiding Bolt: Action once per Long Rest. Ranged spell attack at 60 ft. On hit deal 7d6 Radiant, and the next attack against the target gains Advantage within 2 turns.
fields.Acquisition: Locked chest at the west end of the Open Hand Temple.
fields.Base value: 240 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
